text: You're looking for a recipe that's quick, delicious, and won't blow your calorie budget. This Italian Vegetable Soup fits the bill perfectly. With a cooking time of just 45 minutes, you can have a nutritious and filling meal on the table in no time. The soup is packed with vegetables like potatoes, carrots, and celery, which provide a good source of fiber and vitamins. Plus, it's made with reduced-sodium chicken broth, so you can enjoy the flavors without the excess salt. The shell pasta adds a satisfying twist, making this a great option for a healthy and tasty meal.
